product_overview: A political campaign website that lets the public learn about Deborah Dietzmann, submit volunteer interest, and RSVP to events. It also provides an authenticated admin dashboard for managing events, volunteers, and audit activity.
core_goals: Learn about the campaign and candidate from the public landing page
Submit a volunteer form with contact details and ways to help
RSVP to campaign events from the public site
Log in to the admin area with email and password
Manage campaign events from the admin dashboard
Review and update volunteer signups from the admin dashboard
View audit logs of changes made in the admin area

features.name: Public Landing Page
features.description: Visitors can review campaign information and submit volunteer or RSVP forms from the public homepage.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through campaign information -> Fill out the volunteer form -> Submit the volunteer form -> See the submission complete
Navigate to / -> Scroll through campaign information -> Fill out the RSVP form -> Submit the RSVP form -> See the RSVP submission complete

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Admins can sign in to access protected campaign management pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in invalid email or password -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Password Setup
features.description: Invited admins can set up a password using the password update flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/update-password -> Set a new password -> Confirm the new password -> Submit the password setup form -> See confirmation that the password was updated

features.name: Events Management
features.description: Authenticated admins can view, add, edit, and track campaign events and attendance.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/events -> View upcoming and past events -> Add a new event -> Enter event details -> Save the event -> See the new event in the list
Navigate to /admin/events -> View upcoming events -> Edit an existing upcoming event -> Update event details -> Save the changes -> See the updated event information
Navigate to /admin/events -> View past events -> Mark actual attendance for a past event -> Save the attendance update -> See the updated attendance state
Navigate to /admin/events -> Open the event calendar -> View highlighted days with scheduled events -> Select an event date -> See the matching event details

features.name: Volunteer Management
features.description: Authenticated admins can review volunteer submissions and update volunteer status.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/volunteers -> View the list of volunteers -> Filter volunteers by status -> See the filtered volunteer list
Navigate to /admin/volunteers -> View the list of volunteers -> Mark a volunteer as contacted -> See the updated volunteer status
Navigate to /admin/volunteers -> View the list of volunteers -> Mark a volunteer as done -> See the updated volunteer status

features.name: Audit Logs
features.description: Authenticated admins can review a chronological record of changes made in the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/logs -> View the chronological audit log -> Review changes made to events and volunteers -> See the admin email associated with each change
